text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I do campus patrol rounds every day, sir, 
but the offenders just never seem to go 
away...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Does this mean I'm lacking in dignity, 
perhaps...!? This is a grave matter...!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
How to acquire dignity... Dignity, 
dignity... Dignity... Amazing... Everyone 
will be so impressed...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I know! When it comes to surprises, it's 
all about magic tricks! In other words, I 
just gotta become a Magician Hall Monitor!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san, please perform an escape 
magic trick with me, pleeease!!
